selection_basis: Implementer selection after viewing all 128 primary titles/target metadata, before requesting new member structures. Breadth of biology, not outcomes, hit rates or predictive performance. Four chromatin assays share one conservative planning group. No independent family certification or final reservation.
discovery_change_reason: The preserved 16-gene discovery found only one qualifying assay within its first-128-ID bounds. A separately versioned, pinned HTS identifier census addresses that search-recall limitation without opening outcomes.
owner_direction: 12+ families; estimation with uncertainty, no confirmatory material-effect threshold; more CPU permitted but numeric final cap unresolved.
excluded_scopes: Exposed AHR/PPARG/TP53 and HIV transfer tests
Assuming every pathway screen is direct binding
Treating software LICENSE as assay-data rights
